purpose: Teach the native ORION language model through LoRA to read frozen task-agnostic Stage-1 U before introducing route relevance, driving risk, actions, trajectories, or control.

architecture.stage1_output: Frozen task-agnostic spatial-temporal observation uncertainty U with three components over six camera views.
architecture.language_input: The native 529 ORION visual tokens concatenated directly with 600 frozen U tokens.

data.counterfactual_contract: Except for the exact zero definition anchor, every counterfactual is a permutation of the observed U values and therefore preserves its exact value multiset and amplitude distribution.
data.visual_shortcut_control: All matched U variants reuse the exact same frozen native ORION visual context.

training.event_sampling: Round-robin over thirteen train events with deterministic within-event shuffling.
training.variant_sampling: Deterministic rotation through all six U variants.
training.supervision_per_step: One full six-field answer plus one rotating single-field answer.
training.conditioning_gradient_anchor: Detached leaf required only by re-entrant ORION checkpointing; no gradient reaches frozen visual or U encoders.

claim_boundary: This is a bounded concept-acquisition smoke. It can show whether ORION LoRA learns to read frozen U under controlled counterfactuals; it is not task-relevance, trajectory, closed-loop, safety, or external-generalization evidence.
